sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shekhar Kumar Yadav,J.
1.

This second bail application has been moved on behalf of the applicant Jayendra, who is involved
in Case Crime No. 571 of 2023, under sections 376 (2) N, 452, 323, 504, 506 Ipc and Section 67 I.T.
Act, P.S. Baheri, District Bareilly.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.This is second bail application of the applicant.
The first bail application bearing no. 53519 of 2023 was rejected vide order dated 13.8.2024 by this Court.
4. Contention of the learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in this case.
The applicant has not committed the alleged offence.

The Jayendra vs State Of U.P. on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163760767/
1
applicant has no concern with the alleged incident.
The applicant has no criminal history.
The applicant is in jail since 1.10.2023.

5. Per contra; learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and argued that there is no fresh grounds to consider the prayer for bail and all the submission raised by the learned counsel for the applicant has already been considered, therefore, the applicant is not entitled for bail.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
7. Consequently, the prayer for second bail of the applicant Jayendra, is hereby refused and the bail application is rejected.

Order Date :- 12.11.2024/A.
